alexcrichton opened PR #15337 from alexcrichton:add-linker-docs to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit documents some of the interactions which can happen when a Store is dropped but Linker-defined items it referenced are still used. This could include panics or wrong type-checks because VMSharedTypeIndexes are no longer rooted. This is all benign however insofar as it's exclusively embedder-driven and additionally instantiation cannot succeed (that always requires same-store which will always fail).
